description: Searches CheapestWayz questions and their priced methods for a task (for example "fix a leaking faucet"). Returns matching questions, each with its cheapest method overall and the cheapest DIY, online and local method, costs in US cents, and a page link. Rankings are by cost only; prices are member estimates unless marked source-linked. Store links go through a click-out that may carry an affiliate tag, disclosed in the result.

mode.description: Limit the cheapest pick to one kind

query.description: What the person wants to get done
